article.title: Alexa購物助手加入短訊入口，先向部分美國顧客開放
article.title_en: Alexa for Shopping adds texting for invited US customers
article.summary: Amazon先以邀請方式開放短訊購物，可經文字比較商品、查訂單及提出購買要求。
article.summary_en: Amazon is starting with invitations. Text requests can cover product comparisons, order status and purchases.
highlights: 顧客可在短訊中查詢商品和訂單進度。
Amazon正逐步推出在短訊、網站及App延續同一對話的功能。
highlights_en: Shoppers can ask about items and deliveries by text.
Amazon is rolling out conversation continuity across text, app and web.
article.why: 當購物從對話開始，清楚的規格、價格與商品選項有助顧客比較。
article.why_en: Clear specifications, prices and variants help shoppers compare products in a conversation.
article.next_step: 抽查一組常見商品問題，核對商品頁能否提供準確的規格及款式資料。
article.next_step_en: Check common shopper questions against your product specifications and variant data.
article.detail: 這次變動是顧客可透過短訊使用購物助手，首階段限於部分獲邀的美國顧客。平台亦描述跨裝置延續購物對話的安排，開放程度仍須按帳戶確認。品牌可先從自身資料入手，檢查尺寸、容量、款式和售後條件是否容易比較，並把對話帶來的查詢與實際訂單分開觀察。兩類數字可分開設定報告欄位。
article.detail_en: Texting is the new entry point. Initial access is for invited US customers. Amazon also describes cross-device continuity as a rollout, so check access by account. Brands can audit sizes, capacities, variants and service terms and separate conversational enquiries from orders. Give the two measures separate reporting fields.
article.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
